title: John Mack's final manuscript 'When Worldviews Collide'

tellings.quote: actually the name of his manuscript is When Worldviews Collide.

plain: John Mack, a Harvard psychiatrist, left a last manuscript called When Worldviews Collide, which he wrote in the early 2000s, between about 2000 and 2003. A lawyer named Danny Sheehan, who says he knew the work at first hand, gives its title on the show: "actually the name of his manuscript is When Worldviews Collide." He brings it up because it would show what Mack was trying to say at the end of his career.
